description: Provenance record for every font file bundled with this runtime. A bundled font without an archived license file is a rights gap: doctor.py reports it as a warning and the public-release gate blocks on it. Never add a font here without recording its real upstream source and license.

license_archive_policy.rationale: This repository redistributes the font binary. Redistribution under SIL OFL 1.1 requires the license text to travel with the font. Recording a license id without archiving its text is not sufficient evidence.

fonts.note: Last-resort CJK title face in config/font_policy.json chinese_title, used when no system Noto CJK is installed. The font's family name is 'Smiley Sans' with subfamily 'Oblique'; the policy must match the family, not the full style string.
